longest_dicycle.note: longest_dicycle c: c is a directed cycle (dicycle, reused unchanged: loops and digons admitted, empty and repeated sequences rejected) and no directed cycle of the whole digraph is longer; maximum length, not inclusion maximality; no orientation, connectivity, symmetry or inhabitance premise; exists exactly when a directed cycle exists; reversal is longest in the converse digraph, and in the same digraph under symmetric arcs.
